# Pixel-grid contract provenance

`pixel-grid-contract.json` is an original Chromarchy rendering contract. It
defines a small opaque-white canvas, the 800% visibility threshold, the fixed
black overlay opacity, and the independently calculated source-over result at
a pixel boundary. It contains no third-party image, product asset, UI
expression, or proprietary behavior.

The contract covers a display-only overlay. Pixel payloads, selection,
document history, native persistence, and the meaning of image coordinates are
unchanged.
